title: What It Costs a Godly Man to Say "That's on Me" First
caption:
What it costs a godly man to say "that's on me" before anyone asks who's at fault.

Leadership cost Christ everything. Yours costs less than that.

Own it before the room decides who owns it. Apologize without the excuse attached, because "I'm sorry, but" isn't an apology. Absorb the cost quietly and let the credit go to someone else.

Christ emptied himself and took the form of a servant (Philippians 2:7). Yours is a smaller version of the same move.

#faith #leadership #christianmen #manofgod #humility #servanthood
theme: He leads by going first into the cost.
